review.access: Normal 2024 Wizard spell-list access; learn and prepare through the Wizard's normal rules.
review.scope: Listed mechanics checked against the official current entry or SRD 5.2.1. Tier and acquisition advice are Compendium editorial judgments, not official rules.

compendium.summary: Efficient single-target shutdown when the party can leave the victim undamaged. A strong early control alternative, not an automatic replacement for Web against groups.
warnings: Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
tactics: Failure inflicts Prone and Incapacitated; the target repeats its Wisdom save at each turn end and whenever damaged. Damage-triggered saves have Advantage, so coordinate focus fire elsewhere.
2024 upcasting adds one target per slot level above 1. The old low-Intelligence exclusion is absent. Concentration, range and repeated saves still limit reliability.
